CHAPTER.VERS: Praise Jehovah! Praise God in his holy place. Praise him in his mighty heavens.
Praise him for his mighty acts. Praise him for his immense greatness.
Praise him with sounds from horns. Praise him with harps and stringed instruments.
Praise him with tambourines and dancing. Praise him with stringed instruments and flutes.
Praise him with loud cymbals. Praise him with crashing cymbals.
Let everything that breathes praise Jehovah! Praise Jehovah!
